plan: Represent the recipe as plain JSON-shaped dicts with fractions.Fraction quantities; never mutate inputs (deep-copy on entry), so print_original can return authored_text byte-for-byte after any number of adaptations.
Compute an exact rational scale factor target_yield / recipe_yield and apply it to every ingredient quantity, including quantities of ingredients introduced by substitutions.

Resolve exclusions with a worklist: each ingredient whose name is excluded follows a substitution chain chosen by (priority, catalog index); replacement effects (quantity_factor, unit, preparation, wording_changes, equipment add/remove, yield_factor, additional_ingredients) accumulate in a _Pass record.
Detect substitution cycles with a per-chain visited-name set; an excluded replacement not yet visited emits a warning and continues the chain (reintroduced-exclusion case).

Collect every independent impossibility reason (no substitution, cycle, unavailable equipment) into a set across main ingredients, components, and the post-substitution equipment check before deciding possibility; return them sorted with recipe=null.
Drop optional components that cannot be adapted with a warning; required components contribute their reasons.

On success, apply accumulated wording changes to all instruction strings, sort final equipment, set yield to target (times any substitution yield factors with a warning), regenerate authored_text for the adapted recipe, and return sorted warnings plus the ordered list of chosen catalog IDs.
mechanisms: deep-copy input isolation for non-mutation and exact original printing
rational yield scaling with compounded substitution quantity factors
worklist-based chained substitution including catalog-introduced additional ingredients
deterministic candidate ranking by (numeric priority, catalog order)
per-chain visited-set cycle detection with reintroduced-exclusion warnings
exhaustive reason accumulation in a set, sorted on output
ordered accumulation of wording changes applied as global string rewrites over instructions
set-based equipment add/remove with subset check against available equipment and sorted output
optional-component dropping with warning versus required-component failure
regenerated authored_text for the adapted recipe
